content_units: Best Move-Out Cleaning Pick for Lisbon

For a   92 m², 2-bedroom apartment   with a budget cap of   220 EUR  , the best overall choice is   Quote B at 210 EUR  . It is the most complete option within budget and has the lowest risk of move-out disputes because it explicitly includes key handover areas plus a   satisfaction re-clean guarantee  .
Quote Comparison for Value and Completeness
Quote   Price   Scope Included   Team / Time   Value   Likely Hidden Gaps

A     180 EUR     Kitchen appliances; windows inside only   3 cleaners / 3h   Good price for a faster job   Does not mention inside cabinets; unclear on oven/fridge detail; may skip balcony, interior drawers, and detailed move-out extras

B     210 EUR     Oven; fridge; inside cabinets; windows inside; re-clean guarantee   2 cleaners / 5h     Best overall   for move-out readiness   Still does not mention balcony, exterior windows, walls, limescale-heavy areas, or inside wardrobe storage

C     160 EUR     Standard deep clean only   2 cleaners / 4h   Cheapest, but weak move-out fit   Appliances excluded; cabinets likely excluded; higher chance of add-on fees or an incomplete landlord standard clean

D     235 EUR     Full move-out package; balcony; inside cabinets   3 cleaners / 4h   Most complete scope   Over budget; still should confirm appliances/windows details even if “full package” suggests broad coverage
Ranked Options
Option 1: Quote B   Best balance for move-out handover   Most complete under budget
- Best fit for a move-out clean because it explicitly includes the areas most landlords/agents check first:   oven, fridge, inside cabinets, and inside windows  .
- The   re-clean guarantee   materially improves value; it reduces the risk if the landlord flags missed spots.
- Although it has only 2 cleaners,   5 hours   suggests a more detailed clean rather than a quick surface pass.
Why it wins
- Strongest included scope under   220 EUR
- Lowest likely follow-up cost
- Best protection against quality issues
Main gap to confirm
- Balcony, exterior-facing glass, inside wardrobes, wall marks, and limescale removal are not explicitly listed.
Option 2: Quote A   Best lower-cost alternative   Good if appliances matter more than cabinets
- At   180 EUR  , this is a solid value option if you want to stay comfortably below budget.
- 3 cleaners in 3 hours can be efficient, but it may also mean a faster, less detailed job.
- Better than C because it includes appliances and inside windows.
Why it is second
- Good price-to-scope ratio
- Faster service window
- But less explicitly move-out complete than B
Main gap to confirm
- Inside cabinets are not listed; that is a common move-out inspection point.
Option 3: Quote C   Lowest upfront cost   Weak move-out coverage
- Cheapest option, but likely to become less attractive if appliance cleaning or cabinet interiors are needed as add-ons.
- “Standard deep clean” is usually not enough for a strict end-of-tenancy clean.
Why it falls short
- Highest risk of hidden extras
- Highest chance of failing landlord expectations
Option 4: Quote D   Most complete scope   Best only if budget can stretch
- Scope sounds strongest, especially with   balcony + inside cabinets  .
- But at   235 EUR  , it misses your budget ceiling.
Why it is not the recommendation
- Best completeness, but not budget-compliant
Move-Out Risk Check for Each Quote
For a move-out clean, the biggest inspection-sensitive items are usually:
- Oven and fridge
- Inside kitchen cabinets and drawers
- Bathroom limescale
- Inside windows and tracks
- Floors, baseboards, and corners
- Balcony if applicable
- Marks on walls or doors
- Inside wardrobes/storage
Risk by quote
-   B: Low-to-moderate risk   — best listed coverage
-   A: Moderate risk   — cabinets and some detail items may be extra
-   C: High risk   — likely not true move-out scope
-   D: Low risk   — strongest package, but over budget
Best Decision for Your Budget
Recommended choice: Quote B
It gives you the best combination of:
-   Completeness
-   Move-out suitability
-   Budget compliance
-   Protection against missed areas
If you want the safest handover under   220 EUR  ,   B is the best option  .
If you want to save money and can tolerate more scope risk,   A is the backup choice  .
